intro.title: Props Drilling
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Vue application that demonstrates props drilling by passing data from a parent component down through multiple nested child components. You will learn how to use props to pass data from one component to another, a core concept in Vue for managing component communication. The main technologies involved are Vue components, the defineProps macro, and JavaScript objects. By the end, you'll understand the pattern of props drilling and how to implement it in a structured way.
intro.usecase: Props drilling is essential in Vue applications where data needs to flow through multiple nested components, such as in e-commerce product pages where product details pass from a main container down to image galleries, descriptions, and add-to-cart buttons. This pattern appears in dashboard interfaces where user preferences or filter settings cascade from a top-level layout through sidebar widgets, data tables, and chart components. Developers frequently use props drilling when building complex forms with nested field groups, or in admin panels where configuration data must reach deeply nested UI controls without using global state management.
